Space-preceded the ... menu, paren-preceded see (...) here.

... starts this block, and **...** and *...* are emphasized.

Remainders: four .... and five ..... and six ...... dots.

Short runs stay literal: two .. dots and one . dot.

Relative path ../foo and link [x](../foo.html) are untouched.

Escaped \.\.\. and a\.\.\.b stay literal.

Code `...` and `x...y` are untouched.

Dash controls: spaced x -- y and x --- y, mid-word en--dash.

| col . one | col ... two |
|-----------|-------------|
| a .. b    | c ... d     |
